name: # Each row is one project: its name, then a description.
Watson Home Assistant
text: A voice and text AI assistant inside WhatsApp that reduces the mental load of running a household: task logs, reminders, shopping and a searchable home knowledge base. I built the frontend, backend, prompt logic and voice-to-text pipeline.

name: Watchometer
text: A Chrome extension that scores educational YouTube videos for quality and clickbait. I developed the classification approach with Claude, using titles, thumbnails and comments, and iterated on the edge cases.
